---
title: "About me"
---

Brenda Anague is currently PhD student in Applied Mathematics, at the Department of Mathematics, at the university of KwaZulu-Natal in South Africa. Her PhD is funded by Deepmind Technologies Limited through the African Institute for Mathematical Sciences Research and Innovation Centre (AIMS RIC) in Rwanda.
More earlier, she completed a Bachelor in Mathematics and Computer Science in 2019, and a Master in Applied Mathematics in 2021 from the University of Dschang in Cameroon. In additon, she later graduated in 2022 with a second master in  Mathematical Science from the African Institute for Mathecatical Sciences (AIMS) Cameroon. 

She is currently  working at the intersection of partial differential equations and scientific computing with a particular focus on developing robust computation methods for solving source inversion problems of PDEs using PINNs,  as well as conducting theoretical convergence analysis of PINNs for approximating PDEs solutions.
